A.name: Dawn of war
A.prompt: Act A palette: apricot dawn, dusty gold haze, warm violet-brown shadows, saffron accents.

B.name: Stillness
B.prompt: Act B palette: desaturated blue-grey, hidden sun, cold slate shadows; the only warm color is a thin gold rim on Krishna.

C.name: Vishvarupa
C.prompt: Act C palette: black-violet cosmos, white-gold core light, teal, magenta and gold sacred geometry.

D.name: War dawn
D.prompt: Act D palette: hot orange sun, red dust, burnt umber shadows, electric blue energy on Arjuna.

krishna.name: Krishna
krishna.prompt: Krishna: deep indigo-blue skin, calm almond eyes, faint smile, yellow silk dhoti and upper cloth, low gold crown with a single peacock feather, gold necklaces and armlets, white-gold divine energy with teal edge

arjuna.name: Arjuna
arjuna.prompt: Arjuna: young archer, warm brown skin, sharp brows, curly black hair, white and silver scale armor, blue sash, very tall dark horn-and-gold bow (Gandiva), electric blue lightning energy

bhishma.name: Bhishma
bhishma.prompt: Bhishma: towering elderly warrior, long white beard and hair, white and silver armor, plain brow band, silver-white energy with river-aqua edge

duryodhana.name: Duryodhana
duryodhana.prompt: Duryodhana: broad heavy-shouldered prince, crimson and black armor with heavy gold ornament, mace on shoulder, blood-red energy

bhima.name: Bhima
bhima.prompt: Bhima: massive warrior, dark umber skin, bare powerful arms, saffron dhoti, iron bands, huge mace, wind green-cyan energy

yudhishthira.name: Yudhishthira
yudhishthira.prompt: Yudhishthira: calm upright king, cream dhoti with royal blue upper cloth, modest crown, white royal parasol, steady pale gold energy

shots.title: The field at dawn
shots.description: Wide, long lens, from behind the Pandava host. Two hosts face each other across a bare stripe of earth; standards to the horizon; the low sun sits behind the Kaurava host and turns the dust gold. Arjuna's ape banner rises above every standard.

camera.move: slow crane down and push in

shots.sound: Wind, banners cracking, distant horses, no music.
shots.source: B06 lines 2963-2964 (ape banner above all standards)
shots.keyframe_prompt: wide long-lens shot from behind an ancient Indian army at dawn, two vast armies facing each other across a bare dusty plain, thousands of banners, low sun behind the far army, golden dust haze, one giant ape-emblem banner rising above all others, tiny figures, epic scale
shots.motion_prompt: slow crane down and push in over the army toward the empty ground, banners rippling, dust drifting low, 7 seconds

shots.title: The ape banner
shots.description: Low and long-lens: the gold ape standard on Arjuna's car fills the upper frame, silhouetted against the dawn sun, the banner snapping in the wind.
shots.sound: Single deep drum hit on the cut.
shots.keyframe_prompt: low angle long lens shot of a tall chariot standard topped by a crouching golden ape emblem, saffron banner snapping in wind, silhouetted against a low dawn sun, lens flare
shots.motion_prompt: banner snaps and ripples, sun flare breathes, very slight upward drift, 4 seconds

shots.title: The grandsire's roar
shots.description: Bhishma, white-bearded and towering on his white car, throws his head back and gives a lion's roar, conch raised high. Duryodhana watches from his car with fierce joy.
shots.sound: Bhishma's roar, then a breath of silence.
shots.keyframe_prompt: low angle medium shot of a towering elderly warrior with long white beard on a white chariot, head thrown back in a lion's roar, holding a white conch high, white and silver armor, tall palmyra standard behind, army banners and dust
shots.motion_prompt: warrior throws head back and roars, raises the conch, beard and cloth whip in wind, slow push in, 4 seconds

shots.title: Bhishma's conch
shots.description: Bhishma blows. Silver-aqua sound rings burst from the conch; the Kaurava host behind him erupts with conches, drums, cymbals and horns.

camera.move: locked, camera shake on the blast

shots.sound: Bhishma's conch, then the whole Kaurava host: conches, drums, cymbals, horns.
shots.keyframe_prompt: side view of a white-bearded warrior blowing a large white conch, concentric silver-aqua sound rings bursting outward as hand-drawn 2D effects, army erupting behind
shots.motion_prompt: conch blast, sound rings expand outward on twos, camera shake, 3 seconds

shots.title: Like a thousand suns
shots.description: Hero shot: Arjuna's car, decked with gold and a hundred bells, four white steeds, the ape banner overhead. The sun strikes it full on and it blazes. Krishna holds the reins; Arjuna stands with Gandiva.

camera.move: low tracking arc left to right

shots.sound: Bells, hooves stamping, a rising choir note.
shots.keyframe_prompt: heroic low angle three-quarter shot of an ornate golden Indian war chariot with two large spoked wheels and a hundred small bells, four white horses, a tall ape-emblem banner, blue-skinned charioteer in yellow silk holding the reins, young archer in white and silver armor holding a very tall bow, blazing in direct sunlight, gold glints
shots.motion_prompt: low tracking arc around the chariot, horses stamp and toss their heads, bells shiver, gold glints, 5 seconds

shots.title: Panchajanya and Devadatta
shots.description: Front two-shot, locked and symmetrical: Krishna lifts the white Panchajanya, Arjuna lifts Devadatta.
shots.sound: Breath, cloth, one held drone note.
shots.keyframe_prompt: symmetrical front two-shot on a golden chariot, blue-skinned divine charioteer in yellow silk and a young archer in silver armor each lifting a white conch shell, faint golden halo behind the charioteer
shots.motion_prompt: both lift their conches to their lips in unison, locked camera, 3 seconds

shots.title: They blow together
shots.description: Low three-quarter: Krishna and Arjuna blow. White-gold and electric-blue rings interlock and roll out over the field. Impact frame on the blast.
shots.sound: Two conches, perfectly in tune, then a low boom.
shots.keyframe_prompt: low three-quarter shot of a blue-skinned divine charioteer and a young archer blowing white conch shells on a golden chariot, interlocking white-gold and electric-blue concentric sound rings exploding outward as hand-drawn 2D effects
shots.motion_prompt: conch blast, two sets of sound rings expand and interlock on twos, cloth and hair blown back, 4 seconds

shots.title: Paundra and Anantavijaya
shots.description: Bhima blows the huge Paundra, green wind rings tearing up dust; behind him Yudhishthira, under his white parasol, blows Anantavijaya in pale gold. The twins' conches answer down the line.

camera.move: whip pan from Bhima to Yudhishthira

shots.sound: Paundra: a huge, rough blast. Anantavijaya: clean and high.
shots.keyframe_prompt: massive warrior with dark skin and saffron dhoti blowing a huge ribbed conch, green-cyan wind rings tearing up dust; behind him a calm king under a white parasol blowing a gold-banded conch with pale gold rings
shots.motion_prompt: whip pan from the massive warrior's blast to the king under the parasol, rings expand on twos, 5 seconds

shots.title: The blare
shots.description: Reverse: from among the Kaurava soldiers, a wall of colored sound rings rolls across the sky toward camera and the ground shakes. Foreground soldiers recoil. Impact frame.
shots.sound: Every conch at once, reverb across the plain, then a sub-bass hit.
shots.source: B06 lines 3488-3490 (the blare 'rent the hearts' of the Kaurava host)
shots.keyframe_prompt: ultra wide shot from behind a crowd of soldiers in dark armor, across a dusty plain a wall of white-gold and blue concentric sound rings rolling across the sky toward camera, ground dust lifting in a shockwave
shots.motion_prompt: sound wave rolls toward camera, soldiers in foreground recoil, violent handheld shake, 5 seconds

shots.title: Between the two armies
shots.description: From behind the car: Arjuna turns to Krishna. The light has gone grey. Arjuna: "Place my car between the two armies, so that I may observe these that stand here."
shots.keyframe_prompt: from behind a golden chariot, a young archer in silver armor turning to speak to the blue-skinned charioteer, grey overcast light, two armies ahead, muted cold colors
shots.motion_prompt: slow push in, archer turns his head toward the charioteer, banners still, 5 seconds
shots.dialogue: Arjuna: "Place my car between the two armies, so that I may observe these that stand here." (B06 lines 3498-3499)

shots.title: The empty ground
shots.description: High angle: the single chariot rolls into the bare stripe of earth between the two hosts, dwarfed by them on both sides.

camera.move: high and locked, the car rolls into the centre

shots.sound: Wheels and hooves only; both armies silent.
shots.keyframe_prompt: high angle wide view looking down at a single small chariot with four white horses on a bare stripe of earth between two vast armies, grey overcast light, cold desaturated colors
shots.motion_prompt: locked high angle, the chariot rolls slowly into the center and stops, dust trails behind, 6 seconds

shots.title: Faces of kin
shots.description: Over Arjuna's shoulder, long lens: Bhishma, Drona and the Kaurava princes stand in the front line, close enough to know, too far to touch.

camera.move: slow rack focus across the faces

shots.keyframe_prompt: over-the-shoulder long lens shot past a young archer's silver shoulder toward an enemy front line where an elderly white-bearded warrior and other noble warriors stand on chariots, compressed perspective, cold grey light
shots.motion_prompt: slow rack focus from the archer's shoulder to the distant elders, 5 seconds

shots.title: Gandiva slips
shots.description: Side profile: Arjuna sinks down onto the car floor; the great bow slides from his hand. Krishna stands motionless at the front. Sound drops out.
shots.sound: Total silence except the bow hitting the boards.
shots.keyframe_prompt: side profile of a golden chariot between two armies under grey sky, a young archer in silver armor sinking to the floor, a very tall bow slipping from his hand, the blue-skinned charioteer standing still at the front
shots.motion_prompt: archer sinks down, bow slides and falls, charioteer does not move, 5 seconds
shots.dialogue: Arjuna: "My body trembles, and my hair stands on end. Gandiva slips from my hand." (B06 lines 3519-3521)

shots.title: Krishna turns
shots.description: Close, locked, symmetrical: Krishna, back-lit, turns his face; a thin gold rim and the first halo ring forming behind his head.
shots.sound: A single low tanpura drone enters.
shots.keyframe_prompt: symmetrical close-up of a blue-skinned divine figure with a low gold crown and single peacock feather, back-lit with a thin gold rim light, a fine golden mandala ring forming behind his head, grey overcast background
shots.motion_prompt: locked, he turns his face slowly toward camera, the halo ring draws itself on, 4 seconds

shots.title: The universal form
shots.description: Extreme wide, low: the sky opens. A colossal figure of light with countless arms, crowned, holding mace and discus, fills the heavens inside rotating yantra rings of faces and eyes. The chariot is a speck on the ground line.

camera.move: slow tilt up from the chariot to the form

shots.sound: A cosmic roar built from all the conches slowed down, a choir, then silence.
shots.source: B06 lines 4826-4862 ('the splendour of a thousand suns', line 4845; 'diadem, mace, and discus', line 4860)
shots.keyframe_prompt: extreme wide low angle, a tiny chariot on a thin dark horizon beneath a colossal radiant multi-armed divine figure filling the night sky, crowned, holding a mace and a spinning discus, surrounded by rotating concentric mandala rings filled with countless faces and eyes, white-gold core light, teal and magenta sacred geometry, splendour of a thousand suns
shots.motion_prompt: slow tilt up from the chariot to the cosmic form, mandala rings counter-rotate, light pulses, 6 seconds

shots.title: Arjuna beholds
shots.description: Over Arjuna's shoulder, close: he stands small against the light, the rings of the form turning above him.
shots.keyframe_prompt: over-the-shoulder shot of a young archer in silver armor looking up at a colossal radiant cosmic figure and rotating mandala rings of faces and eyes, white-gold light on his face and armor, deep violet cosmos
shots.motion_prompt: slow push in past the archer's shoulder, rings turning overhead, light flickers across his armor, 4 seconds

shots.title: Arjuna rises
shots.description: Back on the field in a hot orange dawn. Low angle: Arjuna rises and lifts Gandiva high; blue lightning runs along the bow. Krishna takes the reins.
shots.sound: Thunder roll; the war drums start.
shots.keyframe_prompt: low angle heroic shot of a young archer in silver armor rising on a golden chariot and lifting a very tall bow high, crackling electric-blue lightning along the bow, hot orange sun and red dust behind him
shots.motion_prompt: archer rises and raises the bow, lightning crawls along it on twos, camera cranes up with him, 5 seconds
shots.dialogue: Arjuna: "My delusion hath been destroyed." (B06 line 5773)

shots.title: The banner, then black
shots.description: The ape banner snaps against a red sun. Hard cut to black. Title.
shots.sound: Banner crack, one conch note, cut to silence.
shots.keyframe_prompt: long lens low angle of a golden ape-emblem standard and saffron banner snapping in the wind against a huge red-orange sun, red dust, silhouette
shots.motion_prompt: banner snaps three times in slow motion, then hard cut to black, 4 seconds
